880019719600.title: Martindomil Haitian Watercolor Painting Vintage Caribbean Folk Art Donkey Vtg
880019719600.desc: Up for sale is a beautiful, original vintage Haitian folk art watercolor and ink painting by the listed artist Martindomil (Martin Domil). This piece dates to circa the 1970s / 1980s and beautifully captures the vibrant essence of traditional Caribbean village life. The artwork features expressive, stylized figures engaged in daily rural tasks—including a woman balancing a water vessel on her head and a man pouring from a barrel—set alongside a donkey against a lush landscape with a local hut and rolling hills. The bold ink outlines and fluid watercolor washes are classic hallmarks of mid-to-late 20th-century Haitian Outsider and Folk Art.
